description: This Java source file defines the PlainSaslHelper class, which provides methods for setting up SASL PLAIN authentication in Hive's Thrift server, including transport factories, callback handlers, and processor factories.

classes.name: PlainSaslHelper
classes.description: Utility class for setting up SASL PLAIN authentication in Hive Thrift server, including transport factories, callback handlers, and processor factories.

classes.name: PlainServerCallbackHandler
classes.description: Callback handler for server-side SASL PLAIN authentication, validating username and password.

classes.name: PlainCallbackHandler
classes.description: Callback handler for client-side SASL PLAIN authentication, providing username and password.

classes.name: SQLPlainProcessorFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating Thrift processors that handle IP address setting for the ThriftCLIService.

methods.name: getPlainProcessorFactory
methods.description: Returns a processor factory for the given ThriftCLIService.

methods.name: getPlainTransportFactory
methods.description: Creates a SASL server transport factory configured for PLAIN authentication.

methods.name: getPlainTransport
methods.description: Creates a SASL client transport with provided username and password.
